title: Breathing air into water: dual-pathway H2O2 synthesis via aerating amphiphilic supramolecular films
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02150B, Paper
Yan Yan, Bo Yu, Shuya Liu, Xinyu Lin, Zhi Zhu, Yongsheng Yan, Yanjun Gong, Yanke Che, Weidong Shi
Dual-pathway photosynthesis offers a sustainable method for producing hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) from air and water. The main efficiency-limiting step in existing photocatalytic systems is the simultaneous triphasic enrichment and activation...
